title: 带着轻松走回去
description: 两位成人提小包离开岩馆，门外是柔和傍晚街景。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: Two fictional adults leave the gym together carrying small bags, walking at an easy pace through the lounge toward a softly lit evening doorway. The low climbing wall behind them is empty, and the benches and mats look tidy. One adult turns slightly to continue a conversation while both remain naturally proportioned and fully dressed. Compose a warm everyday departure with simple street shapes beyond the door, avoiding readable signs, brands, or heroic athlete imagery. Use a soft graphite-and-watercolor illustration with precise posture contours, luminous color washes, and cool blue balanced by warm ochre. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
